title: kanban ledger tasks/<id>/questions.yaml (format 2)
description: A kanban/tasks/<id>/questions.yaml: the questions a task's agent asked the person, oldest first. Derived from docs/ledger.md (Questions); where they differ, ledger.md is right. Each question is named <id>#<n>. That n is never reused, that the times fit the status (an answered question has answer and answered, and so on) and that n is not used twice are checked by kanban lint, not by this schema. Any other key is allowed and kept.

n.description: Required. 1, 2, … within the task; never reused.

text.description: Required. The question, written for the person: what, why it matters, the options, and the agent's pick.

kind.description: Which kind of decision point (docs/design.md §1.3), or line: a change to the line itself (the gates, roles and rules the work runs on), or scope: which candidates a fix task should fix (for the Chief of Staff; not a decision point for the person).

status.description: open (asked), answered (the answer is in the ledger), received (the agent has it).

asked.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, written as a string.

askedBy.description: Who asked, as by in log.jsonl (terminal:<id>, or a user name).

answer.description: The answer, as the person gave it.

answered.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, written as a string.

answeredBy.description: Who wrote the answer, as by in log.jsonl.

received.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, written as a string.
